# Pinterest

> > Pinterest is a visual discovery and bookmarking platform offering business tools, developer APIs, analytics, and creator resources for content sharing and advertising.

Pinterest provides a comprehensive ecosystem including Pinterest Business for advertisers, Pinterest API and Conversions API for developers, Pinterest Analytics for performance tracking, and Pinterest Create for content creators. The platform supports shopping integrations, ad management, and discovery features for users to organize and share visual inspiration.

## Key Topics

- Pinterest API
- Pinterest Conversions API
- Pinterest Tag
- Pinterest Business
- Pinterest ads
- Pinterest Analytics
- Pinterest API for Shopping
- Pinterest Performance+
- Conversions tracking
- Product catalogs
- Content management
- Pin management
- Board organization
- Discovery features
- Analytics integration

## Developer Resources & API

- [Pinterest Developers](https://developers.pinterest.com/): Pinterest API documentation for developers and integration tools
- [Pinterest Developers Portal](https://dev.pinterest.com/): Developer portal for Pinterest API, Conversions API, and Shopping API

## Business & Advertising

- [Pinterest Business](https://business.pinterest.com/): Pinterest Business hub for marketing tools, ads, and business accounts
- [Pinterest Analytics](https://analytics.pinterest.com/): Analytics platform for tracking pin performance and audience insights

## Content Creation & Discovery

- [Pinterest Create](https://create.pinterest.com/): Creator resources for content creation, audience growth, and monetization
- [Explore the Best of Pinterest](https://au.pinterest.com/ideas/): Curated ideas discovery and trending content exploration hub

## Help & Getting Started

- [All About Pinterest](https://help.pinterest.com/en/guide/all-about-pinterest): Comprehensive guide covering Pinterest basics and platform features

## Optional

- [Engineering Careers](https://engineering.pinterest.com/): Pinterest engineering blog featuring team culture and job opportunities
